title: Guardian Runtime and Bounded Remediation
objective: Run monitoring continuously using OS-native user services while keeping all actions within Effective Policy.

stories.title: Cross-platform user-service runtime
stories.outcome: Implement launchd/systemd-user/Windows task-or-service adapters with one Guardian engine.
acceptance_criteria: Guardian can be enabled/disabled and status inspected consistently.
Service failure does not block manual CLI operation.

stories.title: Notification abstraction
stories.outcome: Provide OS-appropriate notifications with terminal fallback and privacy-safe messages.
acceptance_criteria: Notifications never include sensitive transcript/source content.
Notification unavailability does not trigger stronger remediation.

stories.title: Bounded remediation planner
stories.outcome: Translate pressure/anomaly signals into recommendations or pre-authorized quarantine/reclaim plans without authority escalation.
acceptance_criteria: Guardian action authority exactly equals or is below Effective Policy.
RED pressure cannot bypass artifact ceiling or unknown-state protections.

stories.title: Guardian kill-switch and audit
stories.outcome: Provide immediate local disable and complete ledger trace for every autonomous recommendation/action.
acceptance_criteria: Kill-switch stops future autonomous mutations without corrupting current state.
Every action links detection evidence, policy decision, and sealed plan.
